docs.title: Bioinformatician & Data Science/Engineering
docs.text:
I hold a Master's degree in Bioinformatics from the University of Bologna, and a Bachelor's in Biology. During the program and my internship at the Seragnoli Institute of Hematology (IRCCS Sant'Orsola), I worked on: - Python and R scripts to process biological data - Data infrastructure and reproducible pipelines (Docker, Snakemake) - Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) pipelines for genomic data analysis - Deep learning models applied to protein structure data - Machine learning models on genomic datasets - Statistical analysis, visualization, and reporting

I'm now looking for junior data science or bioinformatics roles — healthcare and life sciences are my first choice, but I'm open to other domains where the same core skills apply.

Below are the projects I've built to show this in practice, not just describe it.

docs.title: Bioinformatics Intern
docs.text:
Seragnoli Institute of Hematology — IRCCS Sant'Orsola, Bologna February 2026 – August 2026

Working on an NGS-based pipeline (UMA panel) for the genomic characterization of Multiple Myeloma.

  • Designed and automated data processing pipelines for high-throughput sequencing data, using Docker and Snakemake for reproducibility on HPC clusters
  • Applied statistical modeling (HMM-based and machine-learning classification methods) to estimate tumor purity from copy number alteration (CNA) data
  • Performed detection and processing of CNAs, SNPs, and structural variants for molecular diagnostics
  • Maintained data integrity and traceability standards throughout, following GDPR-compliant clinical data practices

docs.title: Clinical Laboratory Intern
docs.text:
Nuova Ricerca Private Clinic, Rimini July 2023 – September 2023

  • Supported laboratory operations in a clinical diagnostics setting — sample preparation, traceability, and SOP adherence
  • Executed routine diagnostic testing (CBC, blood grouping, immunoglobulins), validating results against quality control standards
  • Performed contamination-controlled PCR-based assays for targeted pathogen detection
  • Gained exposure to specialized methodologies within the Assisted Reproduction Technology (ART) department
